thread:
Alyssa (Sec): Policy update: repo-level long-lived SSH deploy keys are being deprecated. Enforcement starts 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC. Please migrate to Vault-signed SSH certs or OIDC-based access for CI.

sec-bot: Org scan 2026-03-11 -> 58 repos with legacy SSH secrets. Report: https://go/internal/ssh-secrets-scan

Carlos (Infra): Do we have migration helpers for Buildkite and GitHub Actions?

Alyssa (Sec): Yes. Use redwood/vault-ssh-init image for runners or the Actions snippet in the migration doc. Example snippet provided in the doc: vault login -> vault write ssh-client-signer/sign -> use signed cert.

Priya (CI): What happens at enforcement? CI will get auth errors?

Alyssa (Sec): Pipelines referencing deprecated keys will fail to access secrets ("secret access denied"). We will offer 48h emergency exceptions via https://go/internal/sec-exceptions (infra oncall + sec lead approval).

Emily (SRE): Is there an auto-PR tool?

sec-bot: Tool available: tools/ssh_secret_rewrite.py will detect secrets and open a PR with suggested workflow changes. Review required; it won't auto-merge.

Carlos (Infra): I'll run the tool on critical repos and post PR links here.

Alyssa (Sec): Thanks — prioritize high-frequency deploys and control-plane services first. We'll revoke any remaining keys a week after enforcement and publish a short incident summary if issues arise. DM me for help. :lock:
